description: This Java class `DeleteHolidayCommandHandler` handles delete commands for holiday entities within the organization module of the Fineract platform. It processes delete requests by invoking the corresponding service to delete a holiday by its entity ID.

classes.name: DeleteHolidayCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for processing delete commands for holidays, annotated with command type metadata indicating it handles DELETE actions for HOLIDAY entities.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete holiday command by delegating to the holiday write platform service to delete a holiday based on the entity ID provided in the command.
